comment: App Center's curated catalog. source: apt (Debian), bioconda or conda-forge (into a conda environment), flatpak (Flathub). kind: gui opens desktop, cli opens command in a terminal. Entries whose source is missing on the system are hidden. section groups cli tools in Start (qc, alignment, variants, expression, assembly, workflows, stats, utilities); subcommands are offered in Start's search.
